units.title: from/of/about + on/by/with
units.shortDescription: Made of, hear about, by car, with a knife — предлоги материала и способа.
units.theoryHtml:
from — происхождение: I'm from Russia. He's from Italy. a letter from my aunt.

of — принадлежность и материал: the door of the house, a cup of tea, made of wood.

about — «о» и «приблизительно»: a film about war, hear about the accident, about ten people.

by — способ/исполнитель: by car, by email, written by Tolstoy. with — инструмент: cut it with a knife, write with a pen. on — канал связи: on TV, on the phone, on the internet.

СочетаниеПример
made of/froma table made of oak
hear about / hear fromI heard about it / I heard from him yesterday.
by + транспортby train, by plane
on +媒介on TV, on the radio, on my phone

⚠ Частые ошибки: made from vs made of: of — если материал виден (a table made of wood); from — если видоизменился (bread made from flour, wine made from grapes). in TV → on TV. with car → by car.

Мини-диалог:
— What's this table made of? — Oak. My grandfather made it with his own hands.
— Really? I read about him in the local newspaper. — On the internet more likely!

exercises.prompt: She cut the bread ___ a sharp knife.
The film is ___ (о) a young musician.
I haven't heard ___ (от) her for months.

units.title: Прилагательное + предлог: afraid of, good at
units.shortDescription: Зафиксированные пары: afraid OF, good AT, married TO.
units.theoryHtml:
Многие прилагательные требуют конкретного предлога — их учат парами:

ПараПример
afraid ofShe's afraid of spiders.
good/bad atHe's good at maths.
interested inI'm interested in history.
married/engaged toShe's married to a doctor.
angry with (чел.) / about (факт)Don't be angry with me.
different from/toIt's different from the others.
tired ofI'm tired of waiting.
proud ofWe're proud of you.
worried aboutShe's worried about the exam.
fond ofHe's fond of fishing.

⚠ Частые ошибки: good in English → good at English. married with → married to. afraid from → afraid of. После этих предлогов глагол — в -ing: interested in learning.

Мини-диалог:
— Are you good at languages? — I used to be. Now I'm tired of grammar and worried about speaking.
— Then practise with me! You'll be proud of yourself.

exercises.prompt: My son is very good ___ chess.
I'm tired ___ the same routine every day.
This model is different ___ (от) the previous one.

units.title: up/over/through/along — движение
units.shortDescription: Вверх, через, сквозь, вдоль — предлоги движения и направления.
units.theoryHtml:
ПредлогСмыслПример
upвверхclimb up the stairs
downвнизrun down the hill
overчерез (сверху, перелетая)jump over the fence, fly over the city
throughсквозь (внутри)walk through the forest, look through the window
alongвдольwalk along the river
acrossчерез (поперёк: на другую сторону)swim across the river, walk across the street
intoвнутрь (движение)walk into the room
out ofнаружуget out of the car
pastмимоwalk past the shop

over vs across: over — перелететь/перепрыгнуть НАД; across — пересечь по поверхности на другую сторону.

⚠ Частые ошибки: go throw the tunnel → through (throw — бросать!). cross across the street — тавтология: cross the street уже содержит «через».

Мини-диалог:
— How do I get to the old town? — Go along this street, walk past the church, then cross over the bridge.
— Through the park too? — Yes, it's faster through the park.

exercises.prompt: She swam ___ the river to the other side.
We cycled ___ the canal for two hours.
He walked ___ the shop without looking.
She came ___ the room and sat down.
Be careful when you go ___ the road!
We drove ___ (сквозь) the night without stopping.
